newsitem.title: USA: Intel to build chip plant in Texas--report.
newsitem.headline: Intel to build chip plant in Texas--report.

text.p: Intel Corp plans to build a computer chip plant in Fort Worth, Texas, the Dallas Morning News reported on Friday.
The newspaper said a formal announcement of plans to build the plant near Fort Worth's small Alliance Airport is expected in the next few weeks. It said the plant could bring 1,500 jobs to the area.
It said such plants cost as much as $1.5 billion to build.
A spokesman for the Santa Clara, Calif.-based company would not confirm the report but told the newspaper that Intel planned to expand and had considered the Dallas-Fort Worth area in the past.
